summary: Apimeds Pharmaceuticals US filed a Form 8-K on September 29, 2026, reporting two 12-month commercial technology agreements executed by its wholly owned subsidiary MindWave Innovations. The filing states that MindWave will deploy MindChain as blockchain infrastructure for AQUAE Holdings Pte. Ltd.'s AQUAEChain platform, and will deploy a dedicated Layer-2 subnet for Flash Sports Media Holdings' FlashChain, covering digital broadcasting rights, video assets, and ticket inventory. Consideration includes service fees, ALCI Credits, FLZH common shares, and FLASH TOKEN allocations. No board recommendation, advisor, price per share, premium, ownership stake, or closing date is disclosed.
